import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].dropna().unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=50, 
                color=bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.RdYlGn([(x - occupation_sleep.min()) / (occupation_sleep.max() - occupation_sleep.min()) 
                         for x in occupation_sleep.values])
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(x=occupation_sleep.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'Overall Mean: {occupation_sleep.mean():.1f}')
ax2.legend(loc='lower right')

# Plot 3: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level with Sleep Disorder indication
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df['Sleep Disorder Clean'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_markers = {'None': 'o', 'Insomnia': 's', 'Sleep Apnea': '^'}
disorder_colors = {'None': '#3498db', 'Insomnia': '#e74c3c', 'Sleep Apnea': '#9b59b6'}

for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder Clean'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder Clean'] == disorder]
    ax3.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'],
                label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50,
                marker=disorder_markers.get(disorder, 'o'),
                color=disorder_colors.get(disorder, '#95a5a6'))
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', 
            palette={'Male': '#3498db', 'Female': '#e91e63'}, ax=ax4, legend=False)
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', 
              color='black', alpha=0.3, size=3, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add statistics annotations
for i, gender in enumerate(df['Gender'].unique()):
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]['Sleep Duration']
    ax4.annotate(f'Mean: {subset.mean():.1f}h\nMedian: {subset.median():.1f}h',
                 xy=(i, subset.max() + 0.1), ha='center', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
